note: Faithful transcription of freeform/opus55-freeform-riftwater/scripts into ordered layer operations. Not executable; every parameter was read from the scripts. Group order is the requested one (places, ground, volume, pieces, buildings, dressing, stamps); the script runs ground, volume, buildings (monuments last), dressing, then the mirror, so `pieces.monument-*` carries an `after` hint. `class` A = layer operation, B = library entry + placement, C = made; `new` = no op or template of that name exists in pgmvox or the studio today. Notation: BLOCK:data uses the names in scripts/mc.py (1.8 ids); [a,b] pairs after a block are (block, weight).

ground.gap: fbm = scipy.ndimage.zoom(order=3) lattices over the red-half grid (120 x 176); the seeds reproduce only in an interpreter that implements this noise.

Existing landform.watercourse derives levels from fall_min/reach_min; here two reaches have stated levels (pond 48, river 45) and a weir between them, banks differ per side (7 vs 14), and width grows downstream. Needs: per-reach level, per-side bank, width ramp.
lake(centre, r, level, depth, shore, rz, jag, seed) covers the ellipse; the spit (land tongue into the lake) and the outlet disc are not parameters.
Nearest: landform.scarp (a face along a line) or the relief 'scarp' mark; a ridge whose foot wanders and whose crest carries crag noise is a new landform.
landform.terraces(mask, step, base, riser) cuts full steps; here the ground is pulled 55% of the way to 3-block steps.
landform.stage rings are circular and in blocks; this one is elliptical (rx 12, rz 9.5) and in normalised radius.
landform.spire/butte approximate it; a gaussian mound with an elliptical footprint is not a parameter set today.

underside(mask, top_y, depth=f(d), paint, jitter) has one distance; here two distances (to board edge, to the rift) take a minimum, so the island is sheer for ~26 blocks under the rift lip and tapers elsewhere.
